entries.original_title: Paper page - Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
entries.subtitle: Multics is a video-generation framework that uses hierarchical communication across players, groups, and global levels to address scaling and event-interference problems.
entries.reject_reason: Multics is attributed to Tencent’s ARC Lab, not the tracked Tencent Hunyuan entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
entries.subtitle: The study finds rubric-based reinforcement learning can reward irrelevant advice when weighted scores let models offset a missed key decision, leading to worse clinical answers.
entries.reject_reason: The paper is attributed to ByteDance but is not identified as research from the tracked ByteDance Seed lab.

entries.original_title: From Enterprise to Earthshot: UK’s Ecosystem Moves From Ambition to Application With NVIDIA
entries.subtitle: NVIDIA committed $250 million in compute over five years for U.K. agentic safety and security research and joined the Earthshot Prize to support climate innovators.
entries.reject_reason: This NVIDIA roundup focuses on partnerships and customers’ applications rather than a qualifying NVIDIA launch or research result.

entries.original_title: European Cities Deploy NVIDIA-Powered AI Agents to Run Smarter Urban Operations
entries.subtitle: Cities across EMEA use NVIDIA computing to build AI agents and digital twins that help teams plan maintenance, use energy efficiently, and improve public services.
entries.reject_reason: The article describes cities and partners deploying existing NVIDIA technology, not a new NVIDIA product or research result.

entries.original_title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
entries.subtitle: OpenAI’s analysis finds agentic AI use is growing among EU enterprises and small businesses, while deeper adoption could create more value.
entries.reject_reason: OpenAI’s brief analysis of EU agentic AI adoption does not describe a new technique, benchmark, research result, or product.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
entries.subtitle: Agent-Reflex is a training framework that encourages language agents to reflect proactively and recover from failures after noisy tool feedback or user corrections.
entries.reject_reason: Agent-Reflex comes from an untracked research team, and its use of Qwen as a base model is not a Qwen research announcement.

entries.original_title: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
entries.subtitle: Anthropic opened its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signed an MOU with the government to cooperate on AI safety and evaluation.
entries.reject_reason: Anthropic’s Singapore office and government agreement do not announce a research result, product launch, or model release.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
entries.subtitle: Urbex lets vision-language agents search city-scale 3D scenes interactively, which may make object grounding more efficient in large outdoor areas.
entries.reject_reason: Urbex is research from an untracked team; appearing on a tracked paper site does not make it research by that tracker.

entries.original_title: Paper page - VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
entries.subtitle: VideoJev treats video understanding and interaction as decision tasks, using video evidence to score time spans and text choices.
entries.reject_reason: VideoJev is university research listed on a paper site, not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
entries.subtitle: Vela proposes user behavior as training data so language models can infer preferences, intent, and likely future actions from long-term histories.
entries.reject_reason: Vela is attributed to an untracked research group, while Qwen is only the model used in its experiments.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
entries.subtitle: Jeva proposes a decision-native model architecture designed to distinguish no answer from uncertainty, handle reordered choices, scale options, and reuse computations.
entries.reject_reason: Jeva is university research rather than a development from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
entries.subtitle: TPPO uses cumulative value outputs to track changing token values in language-model reasoning, addressing limits of standard critics under sparse rewards.
entries.reject_reason: TPPO is from an untracked research team and merely evaluates its method on Qwen models.

entries.original_title: Paper page - X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning
entries.subtitle: X-Ragent trains medical agents to learn when to seek extra evidence and prevent irrelevant measurements from entering chest X-ray reasoning.
entries.reject_reason: X-Ragent is research from an untracked university team, and using Qwen as a base model does not make it a tracked-entity result.

entries.original_title: How Amazon’s $100 million Right Now Climate Fund is protecting and restoring nature around the world
entries.subtitle: Amazon will invest ¥220 million ($1.4 million) through 2030 to restore up to 20 Japanese forest sites totaling 100 hectares and support environmental education.
entries.reject_reason: Amazon’s conservation investments are unrelated to the listed AI interests.
